channel.title: NPR Programs: Morning Edition
channel.description: Morning Edition takes listeners around the country and the world with multi-faceted stories and commentaries every weekday. Hosts Steve Inskeep, Leila Fadel, Michel Martin and A Martínez bring you the latest breaking news and features to prepare you for the day.

item.title: Trump says U.S. struck deal to take control of 65 billion barrels Venezuelan oil
item.description: President Trump is touting a new deal for the U.S. to access Venezuelan oil fields. Trump says it's a major boon for the American people, but it's unclear when they'll see the benefits.

item.title: At least 15 people missing after Grand Canyon flash flood
item.description: Several people are missing or unaccounted for after severe flash flooding in the Grand Canyon on Saturday caused significant damage.

item.title: NPR spent 2 years tracking deaths from heat. We found a staggering hidden toll
item.description: An NPR investigation found that people in the U.S. are dying from heat much more often than official counts show. We explore the reasons why — and how lives can be saved.
item.content:encoded: An NPR investigation found that people in the U.S. are dying from heat much more often than official counts show. We explore the reasons why — and how lives can be saved.

item.title: Rescuers search for the missing after deadly flood along Nepal-Tibet border

item.title: Closing arguments to begin in trial for man accused of orchestrating Tupac's murder
item.description: Closing arguments are scheduled for Monday in the trial of Tupac Shakur's killing. The rap icon was gunned down in 1996 near the Las Vegas Strip in a gang-related altercation.
